verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a search feature that takes multiple filters, including #tags, dates, daily notes, backlinks and pinned notes, plus semantic search. That covers the tag-filtering part of the story, but full-text matching, property filters, path filters and offline search are not documented. missing for 10: explicit full-text/keyword search, property filters, path/folder filters, offline search, independent hands-on corroboration of search speed.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can instantly search all my notes with full-text search plus filters on tags, properties, and paths — including offline

citations.quote: Reflect's search lets you apply as many filters as you'd like to find the notes you're looking for.
You can filter notes by: Date created or updated, Daily Notes, Where they are backlinked to/from, #tags, Pinned notes
Reflect’s Semantic search lets you find specific pieces of information without knowing the exact words.
